intro: We back artists, designers, filmmakers, and writers who make the hidden systems shaping our lives visible, and explore how they might be improved.
copy: The systems shaping everyday life are not always easy to see.

They run through the tools we use, the food and energy we depend on, the places we share, the resources we waste or reuse, and the ways we organise together. Creative work can reveal how these systems operate, who they serve and how they might work better. Creatives and craftspeople should have a say in shaping them, not just responding to the changes they bring.

From digital infrastructure and the platforms that increasingly extract value from creative work to the physical systems that shape our communities, UNBLOCKED supports creative practice that makes hidden systems visible and helps improve them.
